Name: Ceres
Description: Ag ERP: grain accounting, producer settlements, deferred payments, patronage and equity, 1099s and Canadian tax slips.

Name: GrainSight
Description: Grain management: contracts (incl. price-later / DP), real-time position, hedges, bids, bin inventory and shrink.

Name: ScaleTrac
Description: Scale house ticketing: inbound/outbound tickets, grade and moisture capture, discounts, driver kiosks.

Name: GrainSight Mobile
Description: Producer app: contracts, e-signature, settlements and push bids on the grower's phone.

Name: ScaleTrac Mobile
Description: Mobile scale tickets and driver check-in; a quick add-on that can go live in weeks.

Name: Implementation & Data Migration
Description: Fixed-scope implementation, historical ticket/contract migration and go-live support.

Name: Go-Live Training
Description: On-site scale house and office training, scheduled outside harvest and planting.

Name: ScaleTrac Driver Kiosk
Description: Outdoor driver kiosk at the scale: badge or QR check-in, ticket print, no window stop. Cuts scale time per truck.

Name: Automated Probe Integration
Description: Connects the grain probe and moisture tester to ScaleTrac so grade and dockage post to the ticket automatically.

Name: Premium Support
Description: Extended harvest-season support hours (5 am to 11 pm, seven days) and a named support lead.
